si.t: Alert name: On service with another home health/hospice

User Story As an Intake Coordinator or RCM Billing Specialist I want the application to clearly flag patients who are currently "On Service" with another Home Health or Hospice agency and display the relevant episode details So that I can prevent duplicate billing, avoid Medicare/payer claim denials due to overlapping care episodes, and initiate necessary transfer or discharge workflows before completing intake
Pre-requisites 1. The Patient Details screen must display an alert titled "On service with another home health/hospice" within the Eligibility Alerts section. 2. In the Eligibility Alerts table/section, the Description column for this alert must include an active, clickable "View details" hyperlink.
Acceptance criteria On clicking the "View details" hyperlink, it should expand the "Alert details" section. The "Alert details" section should contain the following details: 1. A message to provide insight on the impact of this alert. (Beneficiary appears currently on service with another Home health or Hospice agency. Verify discharge/transfer status before admitting or billing) 2. Then, the list of information as follows: - Service type - Time period - Date - Provider ID - Message

User Story As an Intake Specialist or RCM Billing Coordinator I want the application to display a clear "Medicare Secondary Payer" alert and expose primary insurance details when Medicare is identified as secondary So that we can bill the correct primary payer first, prevent Medicare primary claim rejections, and avoid compliance audits or post-payment demand letters.
Pre-requisites 1. The Patient Details screen must display an alert titled "Medicare Secondary" within the Eligibility Alerts section. 2. In the Eligibility Alerts table/section, the Description column for this alert must include an active, clickable "View details" hyperlink.
Acceptance criteria On clicking the "View details" hyperlink, it should expand the "Alert details" section. The "Alert details" section should contain the following details: 1. Payor type 2. Payor name 3. Address 4. Policy number 5. Phone number 6. Adjustor's name and phone number 7. Date of accident/ Injury (DOA/DOI) 8. Claim number 9. Message

User Story Statement As an Intake Coordinator or RCM Billing Specialist I want the application to display a "Medicare Replacement" alert and surface the specific Medicare Advantage plan details when a patient is covered under a managed care plan instead of Original Medicare So that we can route claims/billing to the correct commercial payer, and avoid immediate Notice of Admission (NOA) and claim rejections from Traditional Medicare Part A
Pre-requisites 1. The Patient Details screen must display an alert titled "Medicare replacement" within the Eligibility Alerts section. 2. In the Eligibility Alerts table/section, the Description column for this alert must include an active, clickable "View details" hyperlink.
Acceptance criteria On clicking the "View details" hyperlink, it should expand the "Alert details" section. The "Alert details" section should contain the following details: 1. Service type 2. Payor type 3. Effective Date 4. Address 5. Policy number 6. Phone number 7. Message
Alert name: Medicare A or B Inactive

User Story As an Intake Coordinator or RCM Billing Specialist I want the application to display a prominent "Medicare A or B Inactive" alert and detail which coverage is inactive alongside termination dates So that we can identify alternative active coverage (such as a Medicare Advantage plan), and avoid rendering uncompensated home health care.
Pre-requisites 1. The Patient Details screen must display an alert titled "Medicare A or B inactive" within the Eligibility Alerts section. 2. In the Eligibility Alerts table/section, the Description column for this alert must include an active, clickable "View details" hyperlink.
Acceptance criteria On clicking the "View details" hyperlink, it should expand the "Alert details" section. The "Alert details" section should contain the following details: - Service Type - Date
Alert name: Eligibility check has identified a change for the MBI

User Story As a User I want the application to flag patients whose MBI has changed and display both the submitted and newly issued MBI details So that I can update the patient's record in our EHR prior to billing, preventing claim rejections and administrative rework
Pre-requisites 1. The Patient Details screen must display an alert titled "Eligibility check has identified a change for the MBI" within the Eligibility Alerts section. 2. In the Eligibility Alerts table/section, the Description column for this alert must include an active, clickable "View details" hyperlink.
Acceptance criteria On clicking the "View details" hyperlink, it should expand the "Alert details" section. The "Alert details" section should contain the following details: - New MBI - Existing MBI If no data is available to display, we can display blanks
